title: Etale algebras are base changes of etale algebras over finitely generated subrings
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $A\to B$ a ring map such that $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then there are a subring $A_0\subseteq A$ generated (as a ring) by finitely many elements of $A$, so that $A_0$ is of finite type over $\mathbf Z$, a ring map $A_0\to B_0$ with $\operatorname{Spec}B_0\to\operatorname{Spec}A_0$ etale, and an isomorphism of $A$-algebras $B\cong A\otimes_{A_0}B_0$ (tensor product formed via the inclusion $A_0\subseteq A$).

source.place: Lemma Tag 00U2 (lemma-etale), item (8) ('Any etale ring map $R\to S$ is the base change of an etale ring map $R_0\to S_0$ with $R_0$ of finite type over $\mathbf Z$'), proof via Lemma Tag 00TP (lemma-finite-presentation-fs-Noetherian) and Lemma lemma-relative-dimension-CM; the statement here is the form with $R_0\to R$ injective, as in Mathlib
